title_sq: NJESI KOMERCIALE, DYQAN PER SHITJE TEK RRUGA NJAZI MEKA!
description_sq:
Shitet njesi komerciale afer Shkolles se Bashkuar ne rrugen Njazi Meka . Ambienti ndodhet buze rruge dhe eshte e pershtatshme per cdo lloj aktiviteti. Lidhur kjo ngushte dhe me aksesin ne rruge kryesore dhe pozicionimin ne nje pjese strategjike te saj dhe me mbi 10 m vetrate. Po ashtu dhe varanda ne dispozicion te njesise e ben ate nje mundesi te mire per perdorim edhe per bar apo restorant, kurse gjuhesh, klinike dentare etj.
Mundesi investimi dhe te kthehet ne apartament.
Ambienti eshte i rikonstruktuar teresisht.
title_en: COMMERCIAL UNIT, SHOP FOR SALE ON NJAZI STREET NEAR MEKA!
description_en: Commercial unit for sale near the United School on Njazi Meka street. The environment is located on the edge of the road and is suitable for any type of activity. Related to this narrow and with the access to the main road and the positioning in a strategic part of it and with over 10 m of parking. Also, the balcony available to the unit makes it a good opportunity for use as a bar or restaurant, language courses, dental clinic, etc. Investment opportunity and return to the apartment. The environment is completely reconstructed.
